title: D-Wave signs quantum chip manufacturing deal with SkyWater Technologies
source_used: The Quantum Insider (13 Oct 2026), which publishes the joint SkyWater and D-Wave press release; Data Center Dynamics page blocked (403)
key_facts: SkyWater Technology and D-Wave Quantum announced a multi-year agreement to continue specialised semiconductor process development and manufacturing for D-Wave's superconducting quantum systems.
The agreement extends a collaboration of more than a decade at SkyWater's Minnesota fab, including manufacturing D-Wave's Advantage2 processors.
The release says the terms protect D-Wave's intellectual property; it gives no financial terms and no end date.
In a separate proof-of-technology project this year, D-Wave's quantum annealing technology optimised maintenance scheduling at SkyWater's fab, cutting lot delays by up to 30%.
A forthcoming proof of concept will extend the model to resource availability, technician constraints and other fab-specific limits.
SkyWater recently launched SkyWater Quantum Solutions to help quantum companies move toward repeatable manufacturing.
SkyWater is tagged by The Quantum Insider as 'Acquired by IonQ'; IonQ's own release of 31 Jul 2026 confirms it completed that acquisition.
quote_evidence: This collaboration extends the long-established partnership between both companies, to continue specialized semiconductor process development and manufacturing in support of D-Wave’s quantum technology roadmap.
The agreement builds on that established technical foundation, with terms that protect D-Wave’s intellectual property as the company advances its quantum systems.
The optimized maintenance schedule reduced lot delays by up to 30%, improving factory throughput.
why_it_matters_hint: D-Wave keeps its supplier of specialised quantum chips, a scarce kind of factory capacity.
notes: Data Center Dynamics (pool source) is blocked; text read on The Quantum Insider, which republishes the joint SkyWater and D-Wave press release. IonQ completing the SkyWater purchase on 31 Jul 2026 is from IonQ's own release (read on ionq.com) and The Quantum Insider's company tag. Barron's also covered the D-Wave deal (headline only).
